name: goAML registration and AML programme pack for real estate agencies, accountants and tax advisers
buyer: Small real estate agencies, sole-trader accountants holding a bookkeeping trade licence, tax advisers, small auditors
trigger: AML act 297/2008 as amended by act 73/2026. In force 1 Jun 2026. Obliged persons must register in FSJ goAML by 30 Nov 2026 (new ones within 30 days). Beneficial-owner checks against reliable sources. FSJ 2026 inspection plan includes full on-site checks of real estate agencies. Failing to register can draw a fine up to EUR 1m.
evidence: https://www.podnikajte.sk/zakonne-povinnosti-podnikatela/novela-zakona-o-ochrane-pred-legalizaciou-prijmov-z-trestnej-cinnosti-aml-zakon ; https://pravnenoviny.sk/?p=20193 ; https://www.minv.sk/swift_data/source/policia/fsj/kpo/PKC2026.pdf ; https://www.akmv.sk/pravne-sluzby/aml-dokumentacia-pre-realitnu-kanceláriu/ (AML pack from EUR 600). Deadline is about 7 weeks from today (9 Oct 2026). A secondary source says 223 agencies answered the FSJ questionnaire in 2025 and FSJ fined EUR 142k in total (LinkedIn, unverified).
existing: Law-firm document packs (AKMV, from EUR 600). Competitor search 'AML softvér / program pre účtovníkov a realitné kancelárie ... KYC Slovensko' found no Slovak KYC or AML app for these sectors; goAML is the FSJ's own free system.
unchecked: Number of obliged small firms (agencies, accountants); whether chamber or association tools exist (Slovak chamber of real estate agents, accountants' associations); whether the one-off goAML deadline fades after 30 Nov 2026, leaving only ongoing KYC, UBO and NOO records; whether the FSJ publishes templates; notary-specific duties.

first_check.duty: Confirmed under Slovak law. Act 297/2008 Z.z., as amended by Act 73/2026 Z.z., has been in force since 1 Jun 2026 (some parts from 10 Jul 2026). The obliged persons named include accountants with a bookkeeping trade licence (not in-house employees), tax advisers, auditors and real estate agencies. Notaries and lawyers are obliged only for certain activities. Existing obliged persons must register in goAML by 30 Nov 2026 (§36d); new ones have 30 days. Registration is electronic only and needs a registration form, a business authorisation document and a named administrator. Podnikajte says failing to register is an administrative offence with a fine up to EUR 1m. Pravnenoviny speaks only of fines in the hundreds of thousands of euros for the gravest breaches. Unusual-transaction reports have been filed only through goAML since 2025. Ongoing duties: beneficial-owner and ownership checks from several reliable sources (now for all clients), a written internal AML programme (§20(2)) with a named responsible person, and PEP and sanctions checks (§10(1)(d)). FSJ inspections often find missing or outdated programmes.
first_check.market: Not verified. Pravnenoviny says only that "thousands" of firms and sole traders are affected. Neither register counts (bookkeeping licences, real-estate brokers) nor FSJ sector statistics were reached; the FSJ 2025 annual report PDF could not be parsed. A partial decode of the FSJ 2026 inspection plan (PKC2026) suggests only about 3 real estate agencies are planned for checks (uncertain), plus off-site AML questionnaires. The LinkedIn figures (223 agencies, EUR 142k fines) remain unverified.
first_check.competitor: goAML registration itself is a free FSJ portal with an FSJ user manual, so the one-off registration step has little paid value. Law-firm document packs exist, e.g. AKMV's AML documentation for real estate agencies (claim says from EUR 600; not re-checked). FinStat sells AML services to obliged persons, with PEP-database checks via portal or API, which partly covers screening. International KYC vendors (Sumsub, with a Slovak page) do ID, PEP and sanctions checks. No Slovak SaaS was found that bundles the internal AML programme, client checks and beneficial-owner records, risk scoring and report preparation for small agencies or accountants. Searches for KROS or other accounting-software AML modules found nothing (not confirmed absent). Chamber or association tools (NARKS, SKDP, SKAU) were not checked.
first_check.reason: The duty is real. Act 73/2026 amends Act 297/2008 and has been in force since 1 Jun 2026. Existing obliged persons must register in goAML by 30 Nov 2026. Podnikajte says a missed registration can draw a fine up to EUR 1m. Beneficial-owner checks against several sources now apply to all clients. Unusual-transaction reports have gone only through goAML since 2025. Registration itself is free and fast, so the paid job is the ongoing work: the internal AML programme, KYC and beneficial-owner records. Only partial competitors turned up: law-firm packs (AKMV), FinStat's PEP/AML screening, and Sumsub. No Slovak SME AML workflow app was found. Enforcement looks light (the 2026 plan possibly covers only 3 agencies, on a partly decoded read). The deadline peak fades after November, and the market size was not checked.

challenge_check.killer: None found. Partial overlaps: goAML registration is free and one-off (FSJ). FinStat AML covers PEP, sanctions and beneficial-owner screening. AKMV sells law-firm AML document packs.
challenge_check.reason: I found nothing that kills it. I found no Slovak SaaS that bundles the internal AML programme (§20), client checks and beneficial-owner records, risk scoring and the annual training log for real estate agencies, accountants or tax advisers. No templates or tools from the chambers or associations turned up (NARKS, SKDP), though I did not check their member areas. Partial overlaps: goAML registration is free and one-off, so it has little paid value. FinStat AML covers beneficial-owner, PEP and sanctions screening; its price was not found and its page returned 403. Law-firm packs (AKMV, from EUR 600) cover the programme document. UK tools such as AMLHUB and AMLCheck are not adapted to Slovak law. Pravne noviny says only 'thousands of firms and sole traders' are affected, without a count. Sole-trader accountants are likely to pay little. After 30 Nov the recurring core is client checks, records and programme updates. I score it below the first check.
